mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (product_code, product_name, category_id, unit, description, cost_price, created_by_id, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{categoryId}, #{unit}, #{description}, #{costPrice}, #{createdById}, #{updatedById}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_name = VALUES(product_name), category_id = VALUES(category_id), description = VALUES(description), cost_price = COALESCE(VALUES(cost_price), cost_price), updated_at = NOW(), updated_by_id = VALUES(updated_by_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM product_categories WHERE category_name = #{categoryName} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM customers WHERE customer_name = #{customerName} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM products WHERE product_name = #{productName} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM warehouses WHERE (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) AND (warehouse_name = #{name} OR warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')) LIMIT 1
